projectState.summary: Byte L4c-2 is approved by Claude and merged/pushed to main at e0b302e, completing the L-arc. The melody editor has a collapsed-by-default read-only Evolution panel using the existing editor-<songId> candidate catalog read. It summarizes unfiltered phrase candidates into best/mean fitness per generation plus elite/alive/reserved/purged tally, renders a compact SVG sparkline, and exposes window.phraseEditor.getEvolution() for deterministic inspection. Claude live-verified the summary against an independent listCandidates recompute, sparse/no-evolution handling, collapsed disclosure, and no horizontal overflow. The visible catalog remains non-purged-only and sorted by fitness. No evolution algorithm, persistence endpoint/schema, scorer, renderer, transport, scheduler, or candidate-store logic changed. Carry forward: possible future extension to include dial-<songId> autonomous populations; rare full-smoke editor/transport timing flake did not recur for Claude.
